identity_sources.observation: Mississippi State Department of Health lists Pearl River County Hospital at 305 West Moody Street, Poplarville, MS 39470 as a 24-bed critical access hospital.
The official City of Picayune page describes Highland Community Hospital as Pearl River County's acute-care facility, leaving the current role of the Poplarville hospital unresolved.
The current Pearl River County official site was reviewed for a hospital/operator or pricing route but exposed no facility-specific hospital pointer or MRF.

interpretation: The facility identity and address are corroborated by Mississippi's official health-facility listing, but current operating/scope status remains uncertain because a neighboring official municipal page identifies another facility as the county's acute-care hospital and no current publisher route was found.
